title: Talented super-star Somethn Different does not disappoint in his latest track, "Welcome To London"
htmlContent:
Talented music star Somethn Different is a multi-talented singer and songwriter currently making waves in the music scene with the release of his recent song "Welcome to London." He creates pieces that are similar to the likes of Jay Z and Alicia keys.

Somethn Different, on his latest track, "Welcome to London," brings an ultra-smooth approach to the sound, which works wonders bringing the ultimate vibe to get us invested in the incredible work. His talents stand out in the verses and shine even more in his song's chorus.
